# Neptora Legal Document Automation & Affidavit Management Platform

> Professional court-compliant affidavit drafting, client case management, and legal workflow automation.

- Official Website: https://neptora.ca

- Organization Schema: https://neptora.ca/#organization

## Platform Overview
Neptora is an automated legal platform for generating court-ready affidavits, managing client case files, tracking sworn statements, and automating legal compliance workflows with high-fidelity PDF and DOCX exports.
